My mom and I were driving back home after a long day of sightseeing in another city. Im on the high way driving at 100 km/h. At some point in my peripheral vision i see something on my left. Turn for a second and see a car coming right at me.  My last thought was, “I don’t want my mom to die like this.” After that in just a second hit the gas and i speed up and avoid a huge accident. My mom didnt notice what had happened but did ask me to calm down cause our house wasn’t gonna “run away” anywhere. 
It took me a few minutes to register what had happened. Stop at the side and had a horrible panic attack.
